scope: Local production-build verification in headless Chrome, 200% text simulated by root font-size. Not live production, ranking, indexing or Eve integration evidence.

change.before: Five links inside sentences used text-primary with an underline only on hover. On /service-areas the sentence itself is bold, so the phone link differed from its text by color alone (axe link-in-text-block, serious). The other four were bold in regular text, which axe 4.12.1 accepts as a non-color cue.
change.after: All five use one @utility text-link with the values of .prose a: color --primary, weight 700, underline at rest, 3px offset, 1.5px thickness, 2.5px on hover.
change.required_fix: /service-areas phone link only. The other four changed for consistency with Markdown links, not because axe failed them.
left_unchanged: service-area/[city]/[service] list links (alone in <li>, no surrounding text, rule does not apply)

built_html_scope.other_markup_differences: 95 glossary term pages lose two React <!-- --> text separators because Prettier merged the JSX text around the phone link; rendered text identical.

after.hover_thickness: 2.5px (6 of 6 on a settled /service-areas page, both themes; one probe sample read 1.5px because the lazy map shifted the page under the pointer)

sitewide_axe.before_light: link-in-text-block x1 on /service-areas, nothing else (reused from the 1023-0539 sweep on 38c2fba, same code)

screenshots: 32 captures (16 before, 16 after): the paragraph holding each link at 320px@200% and 1280px, light and dark, on the four routes
